requirement_vague: Verify user deletion fails when user has articles (FK constraint, no cascade delete)

omissions.description: No user deletion endpoint exists to attempt deleting a user by email via DELETE /api/users/{email}.
omissions.reasoning: The requirement depends on calling DELETE /api/users/orphanauthor1@test.com, but the code only defines POST /api/users, POST /api/users/login, GET /api/user, and PUT /api/user. There is no DELETE route for users at all.

omissions.description: The code does not implement the deletion behavior that should fail with a 500 foreign key constraint error when the user has articles.
omissions.reasoning: Because there is no user deletion logic, the service never attempts to delete a user record, so there is no implemented check or database-enforced failure demonstrating that articles block deletion and that no cascade delete is configured.
